name: DimensionalGlass
screenshot_review: The PNG could not be rendered in this session (the image reader returned empty, and a JPEG conversion did too). Certification DOM metrics show 11 visible elements and 6 glass elements, with story copy 'Dimensional clarity'. Nothing beyond a single card is rendered. No tilt or depth can be seen in a static capture, and the code never implements tilt.
material_impl: Shared primitive. The default branch uses OptimizedGlass (159-170), and material='liquid' uses LiquidGlassMaterial (91-113) with quality 'ultra' by default (110). Padding, z-index and depth are built as dynamic class strings: `p-${Math.round(padding/4)}` (185), `z-${...}` (198) and `[transform:${depthTransform}]` (177). No build step generates these, so the padding/zIndex props do nothing on the OptimizedGlass branch. borderRadius is bucketed into md/lg/xl and ignores the actual value (189-195).
motion: Motion primitive fadeIn (82-83) with useReducedMotion gating (54-55). The animation classes 'animate-pulse-subtle' (86), 'animate-dimensional-float' (130) and 'transform-style-preserve-3d' (176) have no CSS rule anywhere in src. maxTilt is only written to a CSS var (139) that nothing reads, so the 'dimensional tilt' does not exist.
a11y: interactive defaults to true (36), which adds cursor-pointer, liftOnHover and press to a plain div with no role, tabIndex or keyboard handling. Every instance looks clickable but is not operable.
api: forwardRef: yes. className is applied twice, to both the Motion wrapper (87) and the surface (132/200), so user layout classes are duplicated. style passes through. opacity, animationConfig and motionSensitivity are destructured and ignored (30, 45-47). elevation accepts a string or number and is coerced with an `any` mapper that is copy-pasted into five sibling files.
ssr: 'use client'. No module-scope window access. The liquid branch pulls in LiquidGlassMaterial.
fake_complexity: Advertised as 'enhanced depth and dimensional effects'. In practice it is OptimizedGlass plus a translateZ with no perspective parent, so the translateZ has no visible effect, and the tilt is unimplemented.
justification: This is a thin wrapper over OptimizedGlass. Its distinguishing props (tilt, depth, padding, zIndex) are either unimplemented or emitted as dynamic utility classes that never resolve. Real depth should come from the material's elevation/depth tokens on one canonical surface. Keep a deprecated alias that maps elevation and depth to GlassCard.

name: FrostedGlass
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered in this session. Certification shows 14 visible and 9 glass elements, with copy 'Soft diffusion'. Code inspection suggests a noise texture at about 0.29 opacity in soft-light plus a sparkle dot grid. That texture-on-glass treatment usually reads as 'generic frosted' rather than first-party.
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with tint 'cool' and depth 2 (142-153), plus three bespoke overlays: an SVG feTurbulence noise data-URI (115), a radial dot sparkle (229), and an inset edge-frost box-shadow with a specular radial plus linear gradient (241-249). Colors use tokens (color-mix with var(--glass-white), hsl(var(--glass-color-*)) glows at 184-194). Dynamic `duration-[${ms}ms]` (158), `rounded-[${n}px]` (168) and `p-${n}` (172) classes do not resolve.
motion: Motion fadeIn plus OptimizedGlass 'breathe' animation, gated by reduced motion (52). useGlassParallax is gated by reduced motion (57-60). The overlay classes 'animate-frost-grow' (211) and 'animate-frost-sparkle' (226) have no CSS. The hover opacity transition uses ANIMATION tokens (257).
a11y: interactive defaults to true (35): cursor-pointer and a hover lift on a non-focusable div. Overlay opacities were deliberately lowered for label contrast (216, 232, 253). ContrastGuard is imported but unused (15).
api: forwardRef with merged refs (126-131). The style/className merge is correct. opacity is destructured and ignored. glow accepts true or a color name. It uses the same copy-pasted elevation and blur maps as its siblings.
fake_complexity: None beyond the decorative overlays. The props mostly do what they claim, apart from the missing animation CSS.
duplicates: OptimizedGlass variant='frosted' (used by ToggleButton glass mode at ToggleButton.tsx:476)
target: OptimizedGlass/GlassSurface material='frosted' (texture as a material token)
justification: This is the most coherent of the surfaces wrappers: tokenized colors, reduced-motion-aware parallax, and contrast-conscious overlay opacity. It is still a separate component for something that should be a material preset (frost texture plus specular) on the canonical surface. Fold the noise and specular layers into the material engine as an opt-in texture, then delete the wrapper and its five-way copy-pasted mapping code.

name: GlassDepthLayer (+ GlassDepthScene, LayeredGlassStack, useDepthAnimation, DEFAULT_DEPTH_CONFIGS: non-root internals)
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. The story mounts layer='mid' with initial={false}, parallax off and hover off (stories:44-48), so the certified frame avoids every motion and parallax path. That makes the frame unrepresentative of default usage.
material_impl: Calls createGlassStyle({intent:'neutral', elevation:'level2'}) (151-153). Every layer gets the identical style: the per-layer config opacity, blur, brightness and shadow (44-124) are never applied, and the useMemo depends on [config] without using it. Only config.transform is used, and only on hover or parallax. The 'overlay' shadow uses a malformed rgba(var(--glass-color-black) / var(--glass-opacity-50)) (122).
motion: framer-motion initial/animate y:20 fade on every mount (158-159). useReducedMotion is called (141) and its result never used, so reduced motion is not honored. whileHover sets transform to translateZ(-50px) scale(1.1) plus a lift (162). Without a perspective parent, translateZ is a no-op and the scale jumps. Parallax writes element.style.transform directly in onMouseMove (180), fighting framer's own transform. useDepthAnimation delays by zIndex*0.1, which is 7 seconds for the overlay layer (286).
a11y: No role, focus or keyboard handling. The mouse-only parallax is fine as decoration. The reduced-motion violation is real.
api: forwardRef: yes. style is explicitly Omitted from props (33), so consumers cannot style it and the glass style always wins. children is required. customConfig fields other than transform are ignored. GlassDepthScene, LayeredGlassStack and useDepthAnimation are exported from the module but not from root.
ssr: 'use client'. framer-motion import. No window access at module scope.
fake_complexity: An 8-level 'depth system' whose opacity, blur, brightness and shadow tables are dead data. Every layer renders the same level2 glass.
justification: The depth table is not wired to the material: every layer renders identical level2 glass. Reduced motion is computed and ignored, the 3D transforms have no perspective context, and imperative style writes conflict with framer-motion. Depth belongs in the elevation token scale of the canonical material, not in a parallel layer enum.

name: HeatGlass
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification textLength is 52, which is only the skip links: the Default story renders an empty orange-glow box with no content, and it still 'passed'. The story is generator boilerplate (stories:32-36).
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with tint 'warm' and a bespoke heat glow box-shadow (176), plus a radial gradient overlay (188) and a hover glow div (217). heatColor uses a token. Width is hard-coded inline to var(--glass-space-80, 20rem) (170), which overrides its own 'w-full' (142); the comment admits this is a Storybook-frame workaround (164-169).
motion: Gated by reduced motion (82). The SVG feTurbulence/feDisplacementMap filter is applied to the content, distorting text itself (203). The classes 'glass-animate-heat-pulse', 'glass-animate-heat-distortion' and 'shadow-heat-glow' have no CSS. Math.random() runs in render for animationDelay (205), which causes a hydration mismatch and a new value on every re-render.
a11y: Text is displaced by an SVG filter when animate=true (the default), which hurts legibility. The surface has cursor-pointer and lift but is not focusable.
api: forwardRef: yes. The SVG filter defs with fixed ids (heat-distortion-0..75) are rendered once per instance (122), producing duplicate DOM ids. Only filter -0 is ever used, so the other three filters are dead.
ssr: Math.random in render causes an SSR hydration mismatch (205).
fake_complexity: The 'heat distortion' is a static turbulence displacement on the content. The pulse and distortion animations reference nonexistent CSS.
target: optional aura-glass/fx entry (decorative effects), not core
justification: This is a novelty effect. It distorts its own content, ships duplicate SVG ids per instance, has a hydration-unsafe Math.random, and depends on animation CSS that does not exist. Its only story is an empty generated box that certification nonetheless passed. It has no place in a premium core surface set.

name: PageGlassContainer
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification shows 36 visible and 35 glass elements in a 'Customer health' demo page, i.e. heavy glass-on-glass nesting.
material_impl: OptimizedGlass, depth 1, tint neutral (97-106). Fixed 'p-5' padding (118). The same blur and radius maps are copy-pasted.
motion: fadeIn and breathe are gated by reduced motion. scrollFade attaches a window scroll listener and calls setState on every scroll event (78-80), re-rendering the whole page subtree. It fades the entire page container down to 0.3 opacity (130-133), so page content becomes see-through as you scroll.
a11y: No landmark role (a page container would naturally be main or region). The scroll fade reduces contrast of all page content.
api: memo plus forwardRef. maxWidth accepts a number or string. dimensionalChildren applies a translateZ with no perspective, so it does nothing. fullPage gives position fixed with inset 0.
ssr: window is accessed only inside an effect. Safe.
justification: Page-level glass is an app-shell concern that already has GlassContainer and the app-shell subpath. The unique features are harmful (whole-page opacity fade on scroll, setState per scroll) or inert (dimensionalChildren).

name: WidgetGlass
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification shows 21 visible and 21 glass elements for a single 'Throughput 18.2k +9.4%' tile: a 1:1 glass-to-element ratio, which points to stacked translucent layers.
material_impl: OptimizedGlass plus raw Tailwind gradients 'bg-gradient-to-br from-white/10 to-white/5', 'bg-white/20' etc. (140-145). These are not shipped, apart from partial coverage in storybook-utility-shim.css. Hover adds 'ring-blue-500/30 shadow-blue-500/20' (177), an off-brand hard-coded blue. The high-priority pulse ring is hard-coded 'rgba(80, 80, 80, 0.16)' (214). Tailwind shadow-md/lg/2xl are stacked on top of the OptimizedGlass elevation shadow (170-172).
motion: Motion bounceIn plus breathe plus a manual setTimeout mount transition (109-116) plus 'glass-animate-pulse' on priority=high. That is three overlapping entrance and idle animations, all gated by reduced motion.
a11y: cursor-pointer and active:scale on a non-focusable div by default (interactive defaults to true).
api: memo plus forwardRef. widgetType and priority props. opacity is ignored. priority maps to a z-index of 1/5/10 inline (191), which leaks stacking-context side effects.
ssr: Safe. The setTimeout runs in an effect.
justification: This is a card with off-system colors (blue ring, gray rgba), stacked shadows on top of the material's own elevation, and three redundant entrance animations. It adds nothing a canonical GlassCard with elevation and interactive variants should not already cover.

name: GlassDashboard
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification text shows 'Sales Chart / Sales Over Timeline': the default chart renderer is a placeholder box containing the text '<chartType> Chart' (328-334), not a chart. A dashboard template whose chart tile is a labeled gray box will not survive a premium screenshot.
material_impl: Composes GlassCard, Glass, GlassGrid and PageHeader. Imports templateNeutral.css. Raw Tailwind remains ('hover:ring-primary/50', 'text-success', 'text-destructive' at 314, 513), much of it absent from the shipped CSS. Invented compound class names such as 'glass-min-glass-h-96' (222) and 'glass-group-glass-hover-opacity-100' (524) have no CSS.
motion: Motion slideDown for the add-widget panel. Opacity and scale on drag. Motion handles reduced motion internally.
a11y: Drag and drop is HTML5 only, with no keyboard alternative. Widget edit controls are opacity-0 until hover through a nonexistent group-hover class (524), so they may be permanently invisible or visible depending on CSS. Emoji icons '🗑️' and '⚙️' (528, 537) and leftIcon 'Edit' rendered as a text icon next to the label 'Edit' (445). The configure button has an empty handler (540-542).
api: forwardRef, but the loading and emptyState branches return early without the ref, className or props (407-417). widget.position is stored and updated on drop but never used for grid placement: widgets render in array order (481), so the 'drag-and-drop dashboard' does not reposition anything. handleAddWidget has a scan bug: when (0,0) is free the outer-loop break test fails, so it skips to (0,1) (273-283). Width, height and maxHeight props are well designed.
fake_complexity: The headline 'Drag-and-drop dashboard' (169) is fake: drop updates a position that the grid ignores. The default chart widget is a text placeholder. The configure action is a no-op.
target: single workspace/dashboard template using real chart components and a real layout model
justification: A dashboard template is a legitimate flagship surface, but this one fakes its core features: position-based drag-and-drop never affects layout, the chart tile is a placeholder, and the configure action does nothing. Rebuild it on GlassGrid with explicit grid-area placement, keyboard reordering, real chart widgets, and a single dashboard family shared with src/components/dashboard.

name: ChartWidget
sub_exports: src/components/templates/dashboard/index.ts re-exports ./widgets, but no root or package subpath imports that barrel
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification text 'W1…W6W1…W6' shows the labels rendered twice (axis labels at 300-309 plus the legend at 480-497). The line chart uses preserveAspectRatio='none' (251), so strokes and circles are non-uniformly stretched and the dots render as ovals.
material_impl: Glass primitive. Palette uses tokens (127-170). Mixes `hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))` with bare `var(--glass-color-secondary)`, which is inconsistent token typing. The grid stroke is color-mix white 18%.
motion: Bar Motion slideUp with staggered delays. Motion honors reduced motion. The loading spinner uses glass-animate-spin.
a11y: SVG charts have no role='img', title or desc, and there is no data-table fallback. Bar tooltips rely on the title attribute only. Hover-only interactivity. Color-only series encoding in the pie chart.
api: forwardRef: yes. type 'area' renders the line chart and 'donut' renders the pie: claimed types are not implemented. The interactive prop is unused except as a pass-through. There are dead ternaries such as `renderLineChart ? … : 'Line chart not available'` (447-466). A single data point divides by zero (240). `summary.total &&` hides a legitimate 0 (537).
fake_complexity: Lists 6 chart types but implements 4. Area and donut are aliases.
justification: This is an unexported hand-rolled SVG chart that duplicates the root-exported GlassChartWidget and the charts module. It has distorted rendering (preserveAspectRatio none), aliased chart types, duplicate labels, and no chart accessibility.

name: MetricWidget
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification text shows 'Progress 0%' next to '$128.4k': target progress only works for numeric values (190), so the certified story shows a broken 0% progress bar. Trend icons are the emoji '↗️'/'↘️' (162-163), which render as colored OS emoji tiles.
material_impl: GlassCore with tokenized text classes. The colorScheme backgrounds use 'glass-surface-primary/5' style utilities.
motion: The progress bar is a Motion element with a width transition.
a11y: The progress bar has no role='progressbar' or aria-valuenow. The emoji trend glyph is not hidden from assistive tech. Change direction is conveyed by color plus the glyph.
api: forwardRef: yes. The trendIcons type wrongly contains intent, elevation and tier (54-61), apparently copy-pasted glass props. `data?.change &&` renders a literal '0' when change is 0 (213, 269, 344).
ssr: Intl.NumberFormat() runs with the default locale, which risks a server/client locale mismatch.
justification: This is the fifth or sixth metric card in the library. It is unexported, uses emoji trend glyphs, and shows a broken 0% target bar in its own story. Merge its variant set into one canonical metric card.

name: TableWidget
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification DOM shows 53 visible and 60 glass elements for a 4-row table, which is excessive glass nesting.
material_impl: Glass primitive. CSS-border triangles for the sort arrows using non-shipped utilities ('glass-border-b-muted-foreground/30', 'glass-border-l-[3px]').
motion: Row fade-in with a staggered animationDelay (321). No reduced-motion handling beyond whatever the CSS class does.
a11y: Sortable th has only onClick: no button, keyboard support or aria-sort (251-271). A clickable tr has no keyboard path (324). Sorting is enabled on every column by default (sortable=true).
api: forwardRef: yes. The 'View All' button has no handler (430-432). The intent, elevation and tier props are declared but just spread into Glass. Local sort is disabled when onSort is provided, which is reasonable.
justification: This is a third table implementation. It has keyboard-inaccessible sorting and a dead 'View All' button. A dense or compact mode of the canonical data table covers it.

name: GlassDetailView
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification shows only 15 visible elements and the copy 'A bounded detail view keeps the certified surface readable': a minimal header-only demo that exercises none of the sections, tabs or sidebar layouts.
material_impl: Composes GlassCard, GlassButton and GlassBadge. Raw Tailwind tab styles ('border-primary text-primary', 'hover:text-foreground' at 389-393) are not shipped.
motion: Motion type='slide' sections. Reduced motion is handled by the Motion primitive.
a11y: Tabs are GlassButtons in a nav, with no tablist, tab or tabpanel roles and no aria-selected (383-404). The collapsible section header is a clickable div. The inner GlassButton has no onClick and no aria-expanded (313-345), so the keyboard path relies on click bubbling from the inner button. Emoji action icons '📤', '🖨️' and '📋'. role='article' on the root (581) is questionable. A field label element is used without htmlFor (278).
api: forwardRef: yes. Bug: style is computed with maxHeight, then `{...props}` is spread after it and overrides it whenever the consumer passes style (570-584). activeTab is used only as an initial value (192), so it is not controllable. The 'link' field type renders arbitrary href values, including javascript: URLs (236-246).
ssr: toLocaleDateString in render risks a hydration mismatch. navigator is accessed only in a click handler.
justification: The structure is a reasonable record-detail template (header, status, sections, tabs, sidebar). It needs the library's real GlassTabs, accessible disclosure sections, controlled activeTab, URL sanitization for link fields, an icon set instead of emoji, and a fix for the style-override bug. The story must show real layouts.

name: GlassFormTemplate
sub_exports: aura-glass/forms (src/forms/index.ts:1); note that package.json maps ./forms import to dist/index.mjs, the root bundle
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification body text is 'No form sections configured Submit': the certified story is an empty form, and it passed.
material_impl: GlassCard and GlassFormBuilder. The step indicator uses raw Tailwind 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground', 'bg-success', 'bg-muted' (319-322), which are mostly not shipped.
a11y: Step circles are clickable divs with no role or keyboard support (306-313). There is no aria-current on the active step.
api: forwardRef: yes. The same style override bug as DetailView (478-490). currentStep is fully controlled with no internal fallback, so without onStepChange the Next button silently does nothing. values and errors seed state only once (187-190). handleSubmit validates and then calls handleNext, which validates again (255-265). The submit button is type=submit, but the template renders no form element; it relies on GlassFormBuilder.
justification: Its multi-step mode re-implements GlassWizardTemplate with a worse step indicator, and its single-step mode is just GlassFormBuilder in a card. The certified story renders an empty form. Collapse it into a single form template with one stepper.

name: GlassFormWizardSteps
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification body text is literally 'Step NaN of 0 0% Complete': the Default story passes no steps and no currentStep, and certification marked it passed.
material_impl: No glass surface of its own. Raw Tailwind 'bg-primary', 'border-border', 'bg-background', 'text-success' (112-116, 163, 343) are not shipped, so the step circles may render unstyled outside Storybook.
motion: Staggered CSS slide-in classes per step. No reduced-motion handling at the component level.
a11y: Steps are divs with onClick: no button, role, tabIndex, aria-current or list semantics (196-205). In the vertical layout no onClick is attached at all (155-193).
api: forwardRef: yes. Bug: the vertical connector condition uses `index < step.title.length - 1` (159), i.e. title string length instead of the step count. showNumbers is declared and ignored (230). completedSteps is a required Set, so it is not serializable and has no default.
justification: This is at least the fifth stepper in the codebase. It has inaccessible div steps, a length bug in the vertical layout, an ignored prop, and a certified story that literally prints 'Step NaN of 0'.

name: GlassWizardTemplate
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification shows a populated 'Setup Wizard' at step 1 of 3 with 81 visible elements. This is the only form template in the shard with a real story.
material_impl: GlassCard and Glass sidebar. The sidebar step buttons use raw Tailwind 'bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20' and 'bg-success/10' (449-453), which are not shipped.
motion: A bare Motion wrapper with no preset (497).
a11y: Uses GlassFormWizardSteps, which inherits its div-step problems. Sidebar steps are real buttons with disabled states, which is better. No aria-current on the active step. No focus management on step change (focus stays on the Next button and there is no step heading focus).
api: forwardRef: yes. currentStep is controlled-only, while completedSteps is internal state: a split brain if the parent jumps steps. Crashes if steps is empty or currentStep is out of range, because currentStepData.title is accessed unguarded (318, 238). handleSubmit validates and then calls handleNext, which validates again (254-262). Auto-save debounce is implemented sensibly (279-287).
target: canonical forms wizard (merge GlassWizard + GlassFormTemplate multiStep)
justification: This is the best of the three wizard implementations: real validation flow, skip support, auto-save and a sidebar layout. It is the right base for a single wizard. It needs controlled/uncontrolled step state, guards for empty steps, focus management on step change, the canonical stepper, and shipped token classes instead of raw Tailwind.

name: GlassDataTable (templates/interactive)
sub_exports: none; the root GlassDataTable (src/index.ts:294) is the different 1400-line data-display/GlassDataTable

stories.nature: Storybook title 'Workflows/Glass Data Table' collides in name with the data-display table story

screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification bodyTextSample begins with the story's inline CSS ('.ag-data-table-story { min-height: 100vh; …'), i.e. the story injects a style block. textLength is 1872.
material_impl: Glass primitive. The search input uses 'glass-bg-background'. Emoji '🔍' search icon and '📭' empty state (120, 210). Unicode ▲/▼ sort glyphs.
a11y: The search input has a placeholder but no label (199-208). Sortable th elements are click-only, with no aria-sort or button (222-234). Page buttons have no aria-current. Emoji are not hidden from assistive tech.
api: No forwardRef. Generic T. Bug: pagination renders only pages 1-5 regardless of totalPages (158). Rows are keyed by index (275). ContrastGuard and TextWithContrast are imported and unused (5-8).
justification: This is an unexported, same-named duplicate of the root GlassDataTable, with a 5-page pagination cap, an unlabeled search input, and inaccessible sorting. It only creates name confusion in Storybook and the inventory.

name: GlassListView
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification body text is 'List View No items found Try adjusting your search or filters': the certified story is an empty state with no data.
material_impl: Composes the data-display GlassDataTable, GlassCard, GlassSearchInterface (768 lines) and GlassInput. The list-mode card stacks 'glass-backdrop-blur-md glass-bg-transparent glass-border-white/40 glass-shadow-2xl' on top of a GlassCard (630), which overrides the material with ad-hoc utilities. The native select uses non-glass styling (475-493).
motion: Staggered fade-in-up on list items. Motion slideDown for filters.
a11y: View-mode toggles are icon buttons with aria-labels but no aria-pressed (432-439). Emoji icons ('📊', '🔍'). The filter label elements have no htmlFor (470). Grid and list cards are clickable GlassCards without guaranteed keyboard access. Row checkboxes have no label (635-646). role=region with an aria-label is good.
api: forwardRef: yes. Declares filter types multiselect, range and date and local filtering logic for them, but the UI renders controls only for select and text (474-509). The pagination contract is confusing: totalItems overrides the local count, and when onPaginationChange is set no slicing occurs. ListColumn (accessorKey/cell) is passed straight to GlassDataTable with selectable, getRowId and other props; type compatibility was not verified.
fake_complexity: Three of five filter types have no UI.
target: collection/list template over canonical DataTable + Toolbar + SegmentedControl
justification: A list or collection template is a high-value pattern, but this one has dead filter types, emoji chrome, material overrides, unlabeled controls, and an empty certified story. Rebuild it as a thin composition of the canonical table, toolbar, search and segmented control with complete filter controls.

name: PersonaPicker
screenshot_review: No certification target. PersonaPicker does not appear in reports/glassmorphism-storybook-visual-certification.json.
material_impl: Bespoke CSS (persona-picker.css), token-driven: var(--glass-gradient-neutral), backdrop-filter blur(var(--glass-blur-md)) var(--glass-filter-base), and --glass-elev-* shadows (81-149). Clean BEM, no inline magic numbers. However, both 'swatches' are the same neutral gradient (183-190), so a persona picker does not preview persona colors at all. Text colors are hard-coded black-on-light rgba (2-13), which breaks on dark themes.
motion: CSS transitions using the persona's own hover duration (78-84). A prefers-reduced-motion block disables transition and lift (229-237). Correctly wired.
a11y: Real buttons with aria-pressed. aria-current is also set (95), which is redundant. role='list' wraps buttons with no listitem children, an ARIA violation (71-75). :focus-visible removes the outline and substitutes the weaker elev-2 shadow (140-143), which is weaker than hover (elev-3), so the focus indicator is poor.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, and no style passthrough. Depends on usePersonaTheme context. compact, contained and maxHeight are consistent with the template props.
ssr: 'use client'. Imports CSS from a component (requires CSS handling in consumers' bundlers).
fake_complexity: The swatches are decorative placeholders that do not reflect the persona palette.
justification: This is the cleanest code in the shard: semantic buttons, token CSS, and real reduced-motion support. As a picker it fails its job, because the swatches show no persona colors. It also needs a visible focus ring, theme-aware text tokens instead of hard-coded black, correct list semantics (or radiogroup), forwardRef/style, a test, and a certification target.

name: ToggleButton (+ GlassToggleButton: module export only, not in root)
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification shows one 'Like' button, with 7 visible elements.
material_impl: glass=false (the default) gives a plain button styled with raw Tailwind palette classes: 'bg-primary-500', 'text-primary-400', 'border-primary-300', 'bg-white/15' and so on (61-133). These classes have no CSS in src/styles, so outside a Tailwind host the colored variants render unstyled. glass=true gives OptimizedGlass as='button' variant='frosted' (459-491). The selected state uses 'glass-text-primary' on 'bg-primary-500' (71), so contrast is unverified.
motion: Motion scaleIn on every mount, with hover animation gated by reduced motion (455-457, 505-508). transition-none under reduced motion (429).
a11y: Native button with aria-pressed via createButtonA11y (387-409). 'outline-none' (425) is combined with the glass-focus class; the visibility of glass-focus was not verified. Disabled uses pointer-events-none plus the disabled attribute.
api: forwardRef via useImperativeHandle plus manual ref assignment, which double-handles the ref (279, 460-471). Rules-of-hooks violations: hooks are called conditionally on props (261-265, 267-270, 274-276), so toggling a feature prop at runtime will crash React. usePredictiveEngine() is called unconditionally (266), and every click records analytics-like interaction data with viewport and time of day, even with predictive=false (323-342). onChange is skipped if value is undefined (365). The size union mixes 'md' and 'medium'. variant mixes color ('primary', 'secondary') with style ('outlined'), and color is ignored for non-outlined variants.
ssr: 'use client'. Imports five 'advanced' modules totaling 6,154 lines (GlassAchievementSystem, GlassBiometricAdaptation, GlassEyeTracking, GlassPredictiveEngine, GlassSpatialAudio) into a basic toggle (18-25), a severe bundle cost. getSafeWindow is used inside the handler.
fake_complexity: The 'consciousness' features are fake. Eye-tracking subscription calls are commented out and gaze does nothing (303-312). Biometric adaptation is fetched and never used. Achievement and audio calls exist but are opt-in.
target: GlassButton pressed/toggle variant (aria-pressed) built on the canonical button
justification: A toggle button is about 40 lines on top of a good button. This one drags in 6k lines of pseudo-AI modules, violates the rules of hooks, records interactions unconditionally, uses unshipped Tailwind palette classes, and contains inert 'eye tracking'. Storybook already files it under Legacy. Replace it with a pressed variant of the canonical GlassButton.

name: ToggleButtonGroup (+ GlassToggleButtonGroup: module export only, not in root)
screenshot_review: The image could not be rendered. Certification shows Bold/Italic/Underline with 14 visible elements.
material_impl: A plain div wrapper. Grouping relies on the child ToggleButton negative-margin and border classes ('-ml-px', 'rounded-l-none'), which are raw Tailwind. OptimizedGlass and Motion are imported and unused (16-17).
a11y: role='group' with no required label. There is no roving tabindex and no arrow-key navigation, and exclusive mode does not use radiogroup semantics. Exclusive mode allows deselecting to null (82), which is unexpected for a single-choice control.
api: forwardRef: yes. Supports controlled and uncontrolled modes, which is correct. Clones children and overrides their size, color and variant, so a child cannot customize them. event.stopPropagation() is always called (76), which breaks parent handlers. The API is a MUI ToggleButtonGroup clone with any-typed values.
target: LiquidGlassSegmentedControl / GlassSegmentedControl (single+multi select) with roving focus
justification: The group's state logic is fine. Visually and semantically it overlaps the segmented controls, which are the premium pattern for this use case. Move the multi-select capability into the segmented control (with roving focus and radiogroup or toolbar semantics) and retire this legacy MUI-style pair.
